stages.name: Empirical Calibration
stages.description: Calibrated against real-world Train-Ticket & Sock-Shop microservice traces. Fits log-normal service execution latencies, Pareto cascading tails, and queue saturations.

stages.name: Gymnasium Environment
stages.description: High-throughput vector simulation (~12,000 steps/sec). Simulates DAG cascading propagation, timeouts, circuit breakers, retry storms, and resource exhaustion.

stages.name: Candidate Model Pool
stages.description: Trains 12 diverse algorithms across 5 distinct paradigm families: Tabular Trees, Deep RL (PPO, DQN, A2C), Contextual Bandits, Graph Neural Networks, and Evolutionary Strategies.

stages.name: Top-5 Selection & Freeze
stages.description: Selects top 5 Pareto-optimal candidates by sample efficiency, recall, and safety. SHA-256 frozen into immutable manifest.

stages.name: Ensemble Formulation
stages.description: Constructs 3 ensemble architectures (Soft Vote, Borda Rank, Gated Controller) aggregating complementary strengths.

stages.name: Rigorous Evaluation
stages.description: Evaluated against Netflix Chaos Monkey, Heuristic Expert, and Random-All across scales N=20 to 500, budgets B=25 to 200, and Family M mesh topologies with rigorous statistical hypothesis testing.

stages.name: Independent Audit & Verification
stages.description: Independent verification audit: 72 pre-registered claims audited, expanded evaluation from n=10 to n=30 systems (3x statistical power), verifying TreeRanker's 2.38x AUDC advantage (p=0.0037).
